title: Normalize Engram binary and home strings at settings ingress
outcome: Engram home is validated and compared after trimming but persisted and passed to spawn/revoke commands untrimmed. A padded path can compare as the same authority store while selecting a different actual --home, skipping required reset/revocation. Normalize home and binary_path once before persistence and use the same canonical request strings everywhere.
acceptance: Persisted settings, runtime argv, revoke targets, validation, and store identity use the same normalized home/binary strings; padded and blank inputs have explicit behavior; cross-platform regression tests cover padded paths and authority rotation/reset decisions.
